tube_rack_insert.reason: Prompt: each tube goes vertically into a front-row end hole. Rack asset frame (fixed yaw 0, front row = smaller x, x=-0.015): leftmost hole (+y) is socket_5, rightmost (-y) is socket_1 (interaction_annotations.json). The tube's centre must lie in the hole's 20 mm top square, its long axis (own +z, cap up, flat base at -z) within 12 deg of vertical, and its centre between 10 mm below and 30 mm above the hole's top point: a tube seated 40 mm deep (100 mm tall, 40 mm into the 50 mm-tall rack) has its centre about 10 mm above it; one inserted only 20 mm has it 30 mm above (the shallowest accepted); one resting on the rim or hovering with its base at the rim has it about 50 mm above (rejected). The 18 mm skirt fits the 20 mm hole, so it cannot rest on the rim by its base. The last segment repeats the result with the hands back home (released). Queries: the rack and the three props must not move (1.5 / 2 cm). Which tube goes in which hole is fixed by the prompt (left tube to the leftmost hole); the arm used is not checked.
